lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu₂Nb₄ (EuNb₂) adopts the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Eu and Nb centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; Eu is surrounded by 12 Nb neighbors (2.96–3.05 Å), while Nb has 4 Eu and 8 Nb neighbors (2.89–3.05 Å). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Nb 12-vertex polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Eu and Nb polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among Eu 12-vertex polyhedra.
